facts.title: Universal Declaration of Human Rights — 1948
facts.text: The United Nations General Assembly proclaimed the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in Paris on 10 December 1948.

facts.title: Peace of Westphalia — Thirty Years’ War
facts.text: The Peace of Westphalia formally ended the Thirty Years’ War in 1648.

facts.title: CEDAW — 1979 adoption
facts.text: The Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women was adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on 18 December 1979.
